The Crow and the Jar

subject: English
text:
A crow was tired and thirsty. It flew here and there. It was looking for
water. The crow suddenly saw a jar. The crow flew down to the jar.
It sat on the edge of the jar and looked inside it. The water was at the
bottom of the jar.
The crow looked around. It saw some pebbles near the jar. The crow
picked up the pebbles one by one with its beak. Then, it dropped them

subject: English
text:
into the jar. The water rose to the brim of the jar. The crow drank the
water. Then, it flew away happily.
